titel: Killer in the Walls: The Crimes of Daniel LaPlante

einzeiler: A rejected teen secretly lived inside a family's walls before committing horrific murders.
kurzfassung: After a teenage girl rejected a boy she met over the phone, he secretly moved into the walls of her family's home and tormented them for months. Months later, after being released on bail, he brutally murdered a woman and her two young children in a neighboring home. He was eventually captured, convicted, and sentenced to three consecutive life terms without parole.
stichpunkte: Tina Bowen received daily phone calls from Danny LaPlante in 1986, but met him in person only once before ending contact due to his deception.
Following the rejected date, the Bowen sisters heard strange noises in their house and found a menacing message written in the basement.
In December 1986, Frank Bowen discovered LaPlante hiding in a bedroom closet armed with a hatchet and a pipe wrench.
Police later found LaPlante hiding in a second-floor crawl space, revealing he had been secretly living inside the home's walls for six months.
After being released on bail in late 1987, LaPlante resumed burglarizing neighborhood homes.
On December 1, 1987, Priscilla Gustafson and her two young children were found murdered in their Pepperell home.
Following a manhunt that involved stealing a van and holding a woman at gunpoint, LaPlante was recaptured at a lumber yard.
He was convicted of three counts of first-degree murder and sentenced to three consecutive life sentences without the possibility of parole.

clips.hook: Found a man standing in the closet with a hatchet and a pipe wrench
clips.text: The father searched the house after noticing signs of a break-in and was shocked to find an armed intruder waiting inside his daughter's bedroom closet.

clips.hook: Living in the walls for half a year
clips.text: Police investigators realized that the young intruder had spent the last six months secretly inhabiting the narrow spaces inside the household walls.

clips.hook: Jumping from a moving vehicle to escape the kidnapper
clips.text: A kidnapped woman bravely endangered herself by leaping out of her moving van at a stop sign to flee from the fugitive.

clips.hook: Three consecutive life sentences with no possibility of parole
clips.text: The judge handed down the maximum possible punishment, ensuring the killer would spend the rest of his life behind bars.

beschreibung:
When Tina Bowen and her sister, Karen, began hearing knocking in the walls of their home in Pepperell, Massachusetts, the girls believed it was their recently deceased mother trying to reach out to them from beyond the grave. In time, however, the knocking became more intrusive and aggressive, and it was soon accompanied by objects being moved around the house and frightening messages left on the walls. After months of torment, the Bowens discovered that it wasn’t a ghost haunting their home, but sixteen-year-old Daniel LaPlante, a boy Tina had briefly dated and who’d become obsessed with her.

Daniel LaPlante was arrested and charged with various crimes, for which he was convicted and served a sentence in a juvenile detention center. Unfortunately, the court’s decision to try LaPlante as an adult meant that he was granted bail and after just one year in detention, he was bailed out and allowed to live with his mother pending trial. It turned out that brief period of freedom was all the time LaPlante needed to find a new object of his obsession and by the time the police learned of his violent intentions, it was already too late.
